seoTitle: Aelnir EMI Calculator: loan EMI, schedule and prepayment offline
summary: Work out EMI, see the full repayment schedule, test prepayments and compare loans. Offline, no account.
tagline: Know what a loan really costs. EMI, amortization, prepayment and comparison calculators that never leave your phone.

features.title: Every loan question, answered
features.lead: Calculations run on your phone and work offline.

items.title: EMI calculator
items.body: Enter the amount, rate and tenure and see your monthly payment, total interest and total cost.

items.title: Repayment schedule
items.body: A full amortization schedule showing principal and interest for every payment.

items.title: Prepayment
items.body: See how much interest and time you save by paying extra.

items.title: Compare loans
items.body: Put offers side by side to find the cheaper one.

items.title: Simple and compound interest
items.body: Quick calculators for savings, deposits and short-term loans.

items.title: Saved scenarios
items.body: Keep the loans you are weighing and recent calculations, with Indian or international number grouping.

strip.label: Calculates
strip.text: EMI · Schedule · Prepayment · Compare · Simple interest · Compound interest

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Your numbers stay on your phone
note.body: Aelnir EMI Calculator is free and supported by ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase is available. Your loans and scenarios stay on your phone.

privacy.headline: Your loan numbers stay on your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. Calculations and saved scenarios are kept on your device. The free app shows ads through Google AdMob, whose SDK collects limited device and usage data, never your numbers.

studioProof.hard: One schedule generator behind every calculator, with exact money arithmetic and tested rounding rules.
studioProof.stack: Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Room · Play Billing
